courses.summary: 卡翁博是安哥拉 Block 32 開發；本課以兩個浮式中心的教學情境研究庫存分配與共同物流。本課依序分析雙中心庫存分配、維修資源競用、不同船體重量敏感度、分流路徑液壓損失、雙中心出貨量閉合，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Kaombo is an Angola Block 32 development; a two-hub teaching scenario studies inventory allocation and shared logistics. The course analyses inventory allocation between two hubs, competition for maintenance resources, weight sensitivity of different hulls, hydraulic losses along split routes, closure of exports from two hubs, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
